description: Audit domains. Every finding, control, and coverage entry belongs to exactly one domain. 'Overall ship readiness' is not a domain: it is the ship gate computed from all domains.

domains.title: Application Security
domains.summary: Input/output handling, injection, web/API hardening, file uploads, webhooks, secrets, administration surfaces, logging and error disclosure.

domains.title: Authentication
domains.summary: Registration, login, credentials, password reset and recovery, MFA, sessions, tokens, cookies, brute-force and enumeration defenses.

domains.title: Authorization
domains.summary: Server-side enforcement, roles and attributes, object-level ownership, tenant isolation, administrative and background-job authorization.

domains.title: Data Protection
domains.summary: Datastore and storage access control, row-level security, sensitive-data handling, encryption, backups security, data exposure.

domains.title: Privacy
domains.summary: Collection, purpose, sharing, tracking, consent, retention, deletion, export, correction, and consistency between privacy disclosures and implementation.

domains.title: Payments / Subscriptions
domains.summary: Payment boundaries, keys, webhooks, idempotency, subscription state, entitlements, trials, renewals, cancellations, refunds, chargebacks.

domains.title: Third-Party Services
domains.summary: Inventory of external services, credentials, data shared, failure modes, vendor dependency and exit considerations.

domains.title: Dependencies / Supply Chain
domains.summary: Dependency inventory, lockfiles, known-vulnerability status, install and build scripts, CI/CD pipeline integrity, package provenance.

domains.title: IP / Asset Protection
domains.summary: Project and dependency licenses, third-party assets (fonts, images, media, icons), attribution, trademarks, user- and AI-generated content.

domains.title: Infrastructure / Deployment
domains.summary: Environments, hosting, network exposure, storage, DNS and domains, CI/CD deployment permissions, preview and staging exposure.

domains.title: Reliability / Recovery
domains.summary: Failure handling, timeouts, retries, idempotency, jobs and queues, consistency, race conditions, backups, restore testing, disaster recovery.

domains.title: Operational Readiness
domains.summary: Monitoring, alerting, error tracking, logging operations, runbooks, rollback procedures, incident readiness.

domains.title: Production Readiness
domains.summary: Production configuration, debug and development features, HTTPS, environment separation, limits and abuse protection for public surfaces.

domains.title: Testing
domains.summary: Unit, integration, end-to-end, security, privacy, payment, webhook, deletion, accessibility, failure-mode, and regression test coverage.

domains.title: AI / LLM Risks
domains.summary: Prompt injection, tool authorization, excessive agency, data leakage, output handling, cost abuse, provider data use, disclosure.

domains.title: Accessibility
domains.summary: Semantics, accessible names and labels, keyboard operability, focus, contrast, motion, forms and errors, dialogs, navigation, alternative text.

domains.title: Legal / Business Risk
domains.summary: Terms, privacy policy, acceptable use, liability, warranty, indemnification, governing law, disputes, subscriptions and refunds, user content, AI usage, vendor terms.

domains.title: Compliance Readiness
domains.summary: Identification of potentially applicable regulatory regimes and the code-observable evidence relevant to them. Never a compliance determination.

domains.title: Documentation Consistency
domains.summary: Agreement between README, product and API docs, policies, help pages, marketing claims, configuration, and actual behavior.
